summary: A button that shows only an icon, with no visible text label.
description: The icon-only usage mode of moz-button: an iconSrc is set with no visible label text, and type includes the "icon" token (optionally combined with "ghost") so the button renders as a square icon-only control. This is not a separate registered custom element — it is documented separately here because it is a distinct, commonly-used configuration of moz-button (see the "button" component for the full element API).

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Path to the icon displayed in the button. Required for icon-button usage — with no slotted/label text, this is the only visible content.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must include the "icon" token to get icon-only sizing/layout (CSS selector `[type~="icon"]:not(.labelled)`). Supported combinations in moz-button.mjs/.css: "icon" (default theme) and "icon ghost" (ghost theme, via `[type~="ghost"]`). Figma Code Connect (moz-button.figma.ts) also lists "icon primary" and "icon neutral", but no matching CSS rule exists for those combos — `[type="primary"]` is an exact match, not a `~=` token match, so "icon primary" does not pick up primary styling.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Used as the accessible/tooltip label when there is no visible text label (common for icon-only buttons since title is rendered on the shadow-DOM button element).

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: Accessible name for the button when there is no visible label text.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Options: default, small, large. Affects icon-button square dimensions via --button-size-icon(-small|-large).

attributes.name: attention
attributes.description: Shows a notification dot on the icon button (badged class applied when iconSrc or type includes "icon" and attention is true).

attributes.name: menuId
attributes.description: CSS selector identifying an associated panel-list menu; integrates the icon button with panel-list open/close and aria-expanded/aria-haspopup state.
